answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must stake cryptographic collateral into an umber vault where a portion is burned whenever duplicate identity clusters are detected. The network enforces superlinear cost scaling: registering $k$ synthetic nodes requires staking $\mathcal{O}(k^2)$ tokens. This creates an unbridgeable economic canyon that exhausts capital, letting only genuine value rise like an unforgeable plume of cryptographic proof.
